entities.summary: Abu'l-Abbas Ma'mun ibn Ma'mun was the Ma'munid ruler of Khwarazm from 1009 until his death in 1017, having succeeded his Abu al-Hasan Ali in that post. He was the son of Ma'mun I ibn Muhammad.
